name: Field Instrumentation & Loop Checking — calibrate, terminate, then loop-check to the control system

activities: process piping/equipment installed with tapping points, thermowells and stubs
sequence.note: Interfaces piping/process_equipment — instruments need their process connections in first.

activities: mount field instruments on stands/brackets/process connections
install control valves, actuators and in-line flow elements
pull instrument cable on segregated containment
home runs to junction boxes and marshalling
sequence.note: Interfaces containment; segregation from power required.

activities: bench/field multi-point calibration of transmitters and instruments
end-to-end loop test field device to marshalling to I/O to DCS/PLC/BMS graphic
valve stroke from the control system

typical_relationships.before: piping/equipment with tapping points and thermowells ready
typical_relationships.reason: instruments mount on process connections that must exist first
tubing connects the mounted instrument to its process tap and air supply
signal cable needs its segregated route installed first
wiring checks need both ends terminated
a loop is verified with a calibrated device, not the reverse

typical_relationships.before: control system I/O and graphics live
typical_relationships.reason: the loop terminates at a DCS/PLC point that must be live and mapped
pneumatic actuators cannot stroke without instrument air
interlocks are proven only once the constituent loops read true

interfaces.requirement: instrument installation requires tapping points, thermowells and root valves in the pipework
equipment must be mechanically complete and flushed so tappings are clean before instruments connect
instrument cable requires segregated tray/conduit at spec separation from power
loop checks require the DCS/PLC/BMS I/O live with database and graphics built
control-valve/actuator commissioning requires clean dry instrument air of verified quality
instrument power supplies (UPS/24VDC) available before loop energization
instrument screen/drain and IS earth referenced correctly
field gas/flame detection loops interface with the detection and shutdown logic

testing_requirements: Tubing pressure/leak test (instrument air and impulse lines)
Cold and hot loop checks field-to-DCS
Interlock/trip and alarm-setpoint verification (I/O to logic)
commissioning_dependencies: Control system (DCS/PLC/BMS) live with database and graphics
Instrument air available, dried and quality-tested
typical_exceptions: Skid/packaged units arrive pre-instrumented and FAT'd — only interconnecting loops checked on site
Smart/HART instruments configured over comms, reducing physical calibration scope
evidence: Loop checks were scheduled before the control-system I/O and graphics were live, control-valve stroke tests were planned before clean dry instrument air was available, and several instruments were sequenced to be looped before calibration.
